questions.stem: Let hinge(z) = max(0, 1 − z). What is hinge(3) + hinge(0.5)?
questions.explain: hinge(3) = max(0, −2) = 0 and hinge(0.5) = max(0, 0.5) = 0.5. The sum is 0.5.

questions.stem: What is the length of the vector w = (6, 8)?
Let L(w) = ½w² + 5(1 − w). What is L′(2)?
questions.explain: L′(w) = w − 5, because the derivative of ½w² is w and the derivative of 5(1 − w) is −5. At w = 2 this is −3.

questions.stem: A logistic regression model predicts class 1 (with the usual 0.5 cutoff) exactly when which condition holds?
questions.explain: The probability is above 0.5 exactly when the linear score z = wᵀx + b is above 0, because σ(0) = 0.5 and σ rises with z.

questions.stem: Which matrix equals its own transpose?
questions.explain: A matrix is symmetric when the entry at (i, j) equals the entry at (j, i). Only the first matrix has the same off-diagonal entries, 2 and 2.
